_note: The prologue scroll (after the Dracula fight) for the JP dub: the English retranslation of 'Akumajou Dracula X: Gekka no Yasoukyoku' (2009) by Gemini (hacking), throughhim413 (translation) and Tom (editing), used with permission. Their text, unchanged; only the line breaks of the 4th and last paragraphs differ, because the PS1 scroll's fixed-width font fits 116 units a line (3 per letter, 2 per space) and two of their lines were wider. One list per paragraph, one string per line. tools/prologue_scroll.py turns it into the scroll script.
paragraphs: After a series of exhausting battles,
Richter Belmont finally succeeded
in destroying Count Dracula,
the ancient vampire who had been
most recently resurrected by
Shaft, the dark priest.
However, one night four years later,
under the bright glare of the moon,
Richter mysteriously vanished.
With no idea of where to begin
her search, Maria Renard set out
to look for him. Along the way,
something happened that would
reveal his possible whereabouts.
The demonic castle of Dracula,
which is rumored to appear only
once every century, took form to
the surprise of all, for a century
had not passed.
At that same moment, one man was
struck with misfortune. A man who
goes by the name of Alucard.
The very same Alucard who had
previously teamed up with
Ralph C. Belmont, and destroyed
his own father, Count Dracula.
Alucard, in order to rid the world
of his own cursed blood line,
sealed off his powers and entered
into what was supposed to have been
an eternal slumber.
But now, that sleep has been disturbed
and Alucard is aware of the evil that
has once again arisen in his homeland.
And at this moment, these souls,
interwined by the fates, gather
together in Dracula's castle...
And perhaps only the moon hovering
in the dark night knows the truth
that awaits them.
